mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin_password_history (pwd_history_id, admin_id, password_hash, changed_at) VALUES (#{historyId}, #{userId}, #{passwordHash}, NOW())
INSERT INTO tb_member_password_history (pwd_history_id, member_id, password_hash, changed_at) VALUES (#{historyId}, #{userId}, #{passwordHash}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin SET password = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = NOW(), password_expire_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{validDays} DAY), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE admin_id = #{userId}

UPDATE tb_member SET password = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = NOW(), password_expire_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{validDays} DAY), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{userId}
